Thanks for telling me, Nadia. I'll keep it between us. I won't pass it to Ruth or anyone else, and I won't post it in any channel.

I haven't done anything with it. Ruth hasn't been briefed, so if you want her to know, you or Mateo should tell her directly. I can help you draft a short note for that if you'd like. Any mail to someone outside pemberline.com would need Ruth's approval first.
